recent_news.headline: This Week in Waste: Top Stories Aug 24 – Aug 27
recent_news.summary: Weekly roundup covering broad waste industry topics including asphalt shingle recycling and landfill gas utilization projects. Does not focus on FOG, grease, or liquid waste segments.

backfill_news.headline: Commissioners approve 50-cent-per-ton tipping fee increase
backfill_news.summary: Allen County commissioners approved a 50-cent-per-ton tipping fee increase to encourage recycling. The rate has remained at $1.35 per ton for over 25 years, with revenues directed to operational costs and hazardous waste facility expansion.

backfill_news.headline: [Date unverified] WEFTEC 2026 - Water Environment Federation's Technical Exhibition and Conference
backfill_news.summary: The largest annual water quality conference in North America featuring 23,000+ professionals and 950+ exhibitors. WEFTEC 2026 will take place September 26–30 in New Orleans and covers wastewater treatment and environmental solutions.
